jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Hacks
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About The Role

When a protocol is drained, or an exchange is compromised, our customers need to know within minutes or hours which addresses to block and where the funds are going. You will own TRM's answer to that, end-to-end.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
, you will lead TRM's hacks category: the metrics, the system that hits them, and the small contractor team that keeps it running around the clock. We align on the outcome; the approach is yours.

The impact you will have

Take command when a big hack breaks and act as a leader. Run the response: triage, coordination across teams, internal and customer communications, and the incident report afterwards.
Get every major hack into TRM fast. Make sure every major hack is visible to customers within hours of the first credible public report, around the clock.
Keep TRM's hack data complete and accurate. Every hack, at any size, is recorded with its entity, theft addresses, date, amount, and hack type.
Follow the money at scale. Design the system, with our Data Science and engineering teams, that carries hack-specific attribution downstream as stolen funds move.
Build the machine with AI. Leverage AI to build the tools and agents to automate key parts of hacks analysis and response, while ensuring human quality control over every output.
Explain how it happened. Root-cause the most important hacks and publish best-in-industry technical analysis that makes TRM the first source cited.
See the next one coming. Build approaches that spot vulnerable contracts before they are exploited, and get them into our product.

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related field.
Has owned incident response in a high-stakes environment (exchange, security firm, incident response, or CTI team): war rooms, incident reports, communications under pressure.
Strong blockchain tracing across major chains (BTC, EVM, TRON, Solana), including bridges, cross-chain swaps, and mixers.
Understands how DeFi, bridge, and exchange exploits work, and how attackers behave after the theft.
Applied AI fluency. We expect you to already be building AI-assisted or agentic workflows in your daily analytical work, to be able to show how you validate their outputs and where they fail, and to treat AI as a force multiplier.
Experience managing contractors or leading a small team.
Writes and briefs clearly, from technical deep-dives to executive summaries.
Hands-on and highly accountable: does the hardest work, not only coordinates it.

Nice to have

Smart-contract reverse-engineering (Solidity).
Experience at a security auditor or blockchain analytics firm.
Experience following specific well-known hacker groups.

About The Team

The hacks function sits within TRM's Primary Intelligence organization, alongside the Facilitation & Money Laundering (F&ML) pod. You will work closely with the Nation States, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Global Investigations teams, as well as with Data Science and Engineering on automation, and with Marketing on publications.

Team Operating Rhythms

Monthly metrics review with your manager.
Weekly operating sync with your team.
Regular syncs with your team across time zones.
A war room, run by you, whenever a major hack breaks.
On-call responsibilities

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE is seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Analyst who will lead high-visibility/high-impact efforts that provide significant contributions to the safety and security of the United States. The position will work closely with sponsor staff and regularly engage with senior leaders to understand their priorities and shape work. Major focus areas include criminal network analysis and disruption, digital marketplaces, and transnational criminal organizations and associated activities. Additional areas of responsibility include cybercrime investigation improvement, cyber-mission systems engineering and guidance, system-of-system engineering, data engineering and analysis, experimentation, communications, and acquisition.

Roles & Responsibilities:

In this role, the selected candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership as a trusted advisor to senior leaders within the sponsor’s organization in the areas of analysis and tradecraft in the fight against crime. Further, the selected candidate will contribute to efforts to:

Conduct Threat Intelligence Analysis: Perform proactive research and analysis of current and emerging cyber threats, with an emphasis on understanding threat actor motivations, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Perform Crypto tracing and Blockchain Analysis: Analyze blockchain transactions to trace cryptocurrency movements associated with malicious activities, collaborating with law enforcement and internal teams to identify potential threat actors.
Provide Attribution Analysis: Perform deep-dive analysis to identify threat actors, correlate various data sources, and leverage cyber threat intelligence databases to establish attribution.
Monitor and Analyze Dark Web Activities: Regularly assess and monitor Dark Web forums, marketplaces, and communication channels to gather intelligence on cybercriminals and their operations.
Develop Threat Reports and Briefings: Prepare comprehensive intelligence reports, briefings, and presentations that translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
Collaborate Cross-functionally: Work with other analysts, engineers, and threat intelligence teams to integrate findings, contribute to investigations, and enhance overall security posture.
Identify and Communicate Threat Trends: Proactively identify trends, vulnerabilities, and indicators of compromise (IoCs) to provide timely intelligence and risk assessments.
Drive Problem-solving Initiatives: Seek out difficult problems within the cyber threat landscape and address them innovatively. Serve as a go-to expert when team members and stakeholders face challenging cybersecurity issues.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
3-5 years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, crypto tracing, digital forensics, or a related field.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, GCTI, GIAC) are a plus.
Relevant prior military and/or law enforcement experience can be accepted in place of formal education and/or experience requirements.
Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex datasets and draw meaningful insights. Ability to think critically, recognize patterns, and correlate disparate data points.
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience in creating analytical reports, summaries, and visual presentations tailored to different audiences.
Self-motivation: Must be a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a proven track record of working independently and tackling complex, novel problems.
Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated ability to work well within a team, share knowledge effectively, and contribute to a positive team environment.
Maintain a presence at the Sponsor Site – Houston, TX
Willingness to travel (up to ~20%)
This position requires a Top-Secret Clearance be obtained and maintained
Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements for a clearance, U.S. Citizenship is required.
This position requires a minimum of 4 days a week on-site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in data science, Cybersecurity, or related field with specialization in areas such as cryptocurrency analysis, blockchain forensics, or Dark Web intelligence.
Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python, R) for data analysis and automation.
Previous experience in monitoring and analyzing Dark Web forums and marketplaces.
Familiarity with intelligence-sharing platforms like ThreatConnect, OpenCTI, or MISP.
Experience with trusted AI or explainable AI techniques applied to cybersecurity and intelligence problems.
Technical Skills: Proficiency with tools and techniques used in threat intelligence, blockchain analysis, and open-source intelligence (OSINT), such as Maltego, Chainalysis, Palantir, or similar tools.
Cryptocurrency Knowledge: Strong understanding of cryptocurrency concepts, blockchain technology, and the role of cryptocurrencies in cybercrime.
Previous work experience in a classified environment, actively participating in cyber threat modeling, operational intelligence, or incident response.
Previous work experience performing (or providing data science support to) targeting analysis for HUMINT, cyber, and/or kinetic operations.
Active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance is strongly preferred.

None

Top Secret

Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our specialized portfolio enterprise where we serve diverse businesses who support unique customers or markets, including animal nutrition and health, bioindustrial, road safety salt and Cargill joint ventures.

Job Purpose And Impact

In this role, you will play a central role in transforming complex growth and performance, research, and commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business. You will analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, understand variation in performance, uncover root causes, and provide recommendations that improve products, processes, and business outcomes.

As a trusted analytical partner, you will collaborate closely with Commercial, R&D, Production, and Field teams to understand business challenges, design robust analyses, and develop insights that create value for customers. You will apply statistical methods, modelling techniques, and modern analytics tools to support both strategic and operational decisions. In addition, you will contribute to strengthening data capabilities across the organization by promoting best practices in data analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with business curiosity and the ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable way.

You enjoy working with data, challenging assumptions, identifying patterns, and translating information into meaningful recommendations.

The position is part of our Cargill/EWOS Aqua Nutrition business in Norway.

Key Accountabilities

Identify untapped opportunities within existing growth and performance, research, and commercial datasets, and recommend new ways of leveraging data to create business value and improve decision-making.
Help shape the organization's data strategy by establishing scalable analytical approaches, improving data utilization practices, and maximizing value creation across the business.
Analyze complex production, research, commercial, and field trial datasets to identify trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
Perform statistical analyses and modelling to generate insights and support evidence-based decision making.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and reliability across analyses and reporting processes.
Identify opportunities to improve data collection, reporting methodologies, and analytical processes.
Contribute to building data literacy and analytics capabilities within the organization through collaboration, guidance, and knowledge sharing.
Develop and maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate insights effectively.
Support commercial initiatives by identifying opportunities, evaluating performance, and quantifying business impact.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Support trial design and evaluation through data preparation, analysis pipelines, and interpretation of results.
Act as a trusted analytical partner, influencing decisions through data-driven insights and recommendations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics,Engineering,Aquaculture, Biology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in data analytics, statistical analysis, and datamodelling.
Fluent English and Norwegian (daily work is in both languages).
Proficiency in analytical tools.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and projects.

jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Hacks
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About The Role

When a protocol is drained, or an exchange is compromised, our customers need to know within minutes or hours which addresses to block and where the funds are going. You will own TRM's answer to that, end-to-end.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
, you will lead TRM's hacks category: the metrics, the system that hits them, and the small contractor team that keeps it running around the clock. We align on the outcome; the approach is yours.

The impact you will have

Take command when a big hack breaks and act as a leader. Run the response: triage, coordination across teams, internal and customer communications, and the incident report afterwards.
Get every major hack into TRM fast. Make sure every major hack is visible to customers within hours of the first credible public report, around the clock.
Keep TRM's hack data complete and accurate. Every hack, at any size, is recorded with its entity, theft addresses, date, amount, and hack type.
Follow the money at scale. Design the system, with our Data Science and engineering teams, that carries hack-specific attribution downstream as stolen funds move.
Build the machine with AI. Leverage AI to build the tools and agents to automate key parts of hacks analysis and response, while ensuring human quality control over every output.
Explain how it happened. Root-cause the most important hacks and publish best-in-industry technical analysis that makes TRM the first source cited.
See the next one coming. Build approaches that spot vulnerable contracts before they are exploited, and get them into our product.

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related field.
Has owned incident response in a high-stakes environment (exchange, security firm, incident response, or CTI team): war rooms, incident reports, communications under pressure.
Strong blockchain tracing across major chains (BTC, EVM, TRON, Solana), including bridges, cross-chain swaps, and mixers.
Understands how DeFi, bridge, and exchange exploits work, and how attackers behave after the theft.
Applied AI fluency. We expect you to already be building AI-assisted or agentic workflows in your daily analytical work, to be able to show how you validate their outputs and where they fail, and to treat AI as a force multiplier.
Experience managing contractors or leading a small team.
Writes and briefs clearly, from technical deep-dives to executive summaries.
Hands-on and highly accountable: does the hardest work, not only coordinates it.

Nice to have

Smart-contract reverse-engineering (Solidity).
Experience at a security auditor or blockchain analytics firm.
Experience following specific well-known hacker groups.

About The Team

The hacks function sits within TRM's Primary Intelligence organization, alongside the Facilitation & Money Laundering (F&ML) pod. You will work closely with the Nation States, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Global Investigations teams, as well as with Data Science and Engineering on automation, and with Marketing on publications.

Team Operating Rhythms

Monthly metrics review with your manager.
Weekly operating sync with your team.
Regular syncs with your team across time zones.
A war room, run by you, whenever a major hack breaks.
On-call responsibilities

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Encompasses technical, engineering, data analytics, cyber security, management, operational, logistical, and administrative support for Bureau of Diplomatic Security, Cyber and Technology Security Directorate in three key offices/functional areas: Cyber Monitoring and Operations, Cyber Threat and Investigations, and Technology Innovation and Engineering State.

About The Role

The Cyber Threat Analysis Division (DS/CTI/CTAD) conducts advanced digital technical forensic analysis and application assessments to support Department of State information, systems, and personnel. Within this division, the Mobile Threat Analysis (MTA) section serves as the primary capability for identifying and mitigating security anomalies within the mobile ecosystem.

The team leverages a wide variety of advanced technologies to perform comprehensive forensic examinations and deep-dive mobile app assessments, ensuring the detection of malicious behaviors, unauthorized data exfiltration, and emerging attack vectors. By synthesizing complex mobile telemetry and forensic artifacts, the team provides actionable intelligence and mitigation strategies to stakeholders worldwide, ensuring the integrity of the Department's mobile environment against sophisticated global threats.

In this role, you will:

Conduct forensic examinations of mobile devices (e.g., Android and iOS phones), including full physical, logical, and file-system acquisitions.
Perform mobile application assessments to analyze behavior, identifying malicious code, unauthorized data exfiltration, privacy risks, and communication patterns within installed applications.
Perform consolidated and comprehensive information and intelligence analysis of mobile threat data obtained from classified, proprietary, and open-source resources to provide awareness to relevant stakeholders.
Analyze and report on unique attack vectors, emerging cyber threats, and current trends used by malicious actors targeting mobile ecosystems.
Assess the cyber threat environment for U.S. missions worldwide.
Ensure that forensic community accepted principles and practices are applied throughout the entire lifecycle of the analysis.
Utilize industry-accepted forensic tools to perform analysis, including but not limited to Cellebrite, Magnet, and other commercial and open-source forensic and app-analysis software.
Collaborate with other forensic analysts, law enforcement officers, and legal experts to identify and recommend methods and procedures for recovery, preservation, analysis, and presentation of digital evidence.
Travel to domestic and overseas locations to provide operational briefings and threat awareness.

CHFI
CISA

Cloud+
CND
CySA+
GCED
GCIH
GICSP
SSCP
Demonstrated experience performing mobile device forensic acquisitions.
Experience analyzing forensic images and data for indicators of compromise (IOCs), root cause and other relevant artifacts pertaining to network intrusion activity.
Strong critical, creative, and analytical thinking skills.
Experience developing technically detailed reports that translate complex technical information to non-technical audiences.
U.S. citizenship and an active Secret security clearance to start.
Ability to obtain final TS/SCI.

Sec+ certification

jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, Hacks
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About The Role

When a protocol is drained, or an exchange is compromised, our customers need to know within minutes or hours which addresses to block and where the funds are going. You will own TRM's answer to that, end-to-end.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
, you will lead TRM's hacks category: the metrics, the system that hits them, and the small contractor team that keeps it running around the clock. We align on the outcome; the approach is yours.

The impact you will have

Take command when a big hack breaks and act as a leader. Run the response: triage, coordination across teams, internal and customer communications, and the incident report afterwards.
Get every major hack into TRM fast. Make sure every major hack is visible to customers within hours of the first credible public report, around the clock.
Keep TRM's hack data complete and accurate. Every hack, at any size, is recorded with its entity, theft addresses, date, amount, and hack type.
Follow the money at scale. Design the system, with our Data Science and engineering teams, that carries hack-specific attribution downstream as stolen funds move.
Build the machine with AI. Leverage AI to build the tools and agents to automate key parts of hacks analysis and response, while ensuring human quality control over every output.
Explain how it happened. Root-cause the most important hacks and publish best-in-industry technical analysis that makes TRM the first source cited.
See the next one coming. Build approaches that spot vulnerable contracts before they are exploited, and get them into our product.

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related field.
Has owned incident response in a high-stakes environment (exchange, security firm, incident response, or CTI team): war rooms, incident reports, communications under pressure.
Strong blockchain tracing across major chains (BTC, EVM, TRON, Solana), including bridges, cross-chain swaps, and mixers.
Understands how DeFi, bridge, and exchange exploits work, and how attackers behave after the theft.
Applied AI fluency. We expect you to already be building AI-assisted or agentic workflows in your daily analytical work, to be able to show how you validate their outputs and where they fail, and to treat AI as a force multiplier.
Experience managing contractors or leading a small team.
Writes and briefs clearly, from technical deep-dives to executive summaries.
Hands-on and highly accountable: does the hardest work, not only coordinates it.

Nice to have

Smart-contract reverse-engineering (Solidity).
Experience at a security auditor or blockchain analytics firm.
Experience following specific well-known hacker groups.

About The Team

The hacks function sits within TRM's Primary Intelligence organization, alongside the Facilitation & Money Laundering (F&ML) pod. You will work closely with the Nation States, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Global Investigations teams, as well as with Data Science and Engineering on automation, and with Marketing on publications.

Team Operating Rhythms

Monthly metrics review with your manager.
Weekly operating sync with your team.
Regular syncs with your team across time zones.
A war room, run by you, whenever a major hack breaks.
On-call responsibilities

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.
Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.
Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.
Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, You Should Expect

Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate
Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity
A high level of personal ownership and accountability
Close collaboration across teams and functions
Frequent, high-touch communication
Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To

Accelerate repeatable workflows
Structure and solve problems
Improve output quality
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy And Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

jobs.description:
About Us

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our Strategic Plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.

About Georgia Tech

Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

Georgia Tech's Mission and Values

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

Students are our top priority.
We strive for excellence.
We thrive on diversity.
We celebrate collaboration.
We champion innovation.
We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
We act ethically.
We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

Job Summary

The Field Office Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) is responsible for developing and implementing security protocols to safeguard information systems. This position focuses on monitoring system performance, conducting security audits, and providing expert guidance on best practices to ensure the integrity of information systems.

In addition to the ISSM responsibilities, the FO ISSM is the Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO) and/or Assistant Contractor Special Security Officer (ACSSO) and performs duties as directed by the Field Office FSO/CSSO to ensure compliance with security operations in accordance with applicable government regulations.

Responsibilities

Job Duty 1 -

Develop and implement security protocols specific to the Field Office for information systems to safeguard sensitive information and ensure compliance with institutional standards and with applicable government rules and regulations (i.e, National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), Intelligence Community Directives(ICD) 705, Department of Defense (DoD) 5205.07, Volumes 1-4, National Security Agency/Central Security Service (NSA/CSS) Policy Manual 3-16, and other regulations related to safeguarding and processing classified information.)

Job Duty 2 -

Monitor the performance of information systems by conducting regular security audits and assessments to identify potential weaknesses

Job Duty 3 -

Provide expert guidance to Field Office personnel on best practices for information systems security, ensuring they understand their role in maintaining security protocols, while working closely with the FO Manager to be a liaison to government customers and sponsors on GTRI and FO policy implementation and process tailoring, recommending additional safeguards or security tools or process tailoring.

Job Duty 4 -

Analyze security incidents related to information systems by investigating breaches and proposing corrective measures to prevent future occurrences.

Analyze current Field Office security requirements and recommend additions as needed.

Job Duty 5 -

Maintain accurate documentation of security procedures and incidents to ensure transparency and facilitate future audits and assessments

Job Duty 6 -

Train Field Office personnel on information systems security policies and procedures, fostering a culture of security awareness among all users

Job Duty 7 -

Stay current on developments in information systems security by participating in professional development activities and reviewing relevant literature

Job Duty 8 -

Provide detailed reports on information systems security status and incidents to senior management, highlighting areas for improvement and compliance

Job Duty 9 -

Collaborate with Information Technology departments to integrate security measures into new information systems and ensure that existing systems meet security requirements

Job Duty 10 -

Perform other duties as assigned

Educational Requirements

Required Qualifications

Associate degree in related discipline or equivalent, related experience

Required Experience

2+ years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Possess a TS/SCI

Experience with RMF to achieve ATO

Experience managing compliance for SIPRNet, JWICS

Preferred Educational Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related discipline or equivalent, related experience

USG Core Values

The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8.2.18.1.2 and can be found on-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/#p8.2.18_personnel_conduct .

Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653 .

Equal Employment Opportunity

The Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Institute is committed to maintaining a fair and respectful environment for all. To that end, and in accordance with federal and state law, Board of Regents policy, and Institute policy, Georgia Tech provides equal opportunity to all faculty, staff, students, and all other members of the Georgia Tech community, including applicants for admission and/or employment, contractors, volunteers, and participants in institutional programs, activities, or services. Georgia Tech complies with all applicable laws and regulations governing equal opportunity in the workplace and in educational activities.

Equal opportunity and decisions based on merit are fundamental values of the University System of Georgia ("USG") and Georgia Tech. Georgia Tech prohibits discrimination, including discriminatory harassment, on the basis of an individual's race, ethnicity, ancestry, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetics, or veteran status in its programs, activities, employment, and admissions. Further, Georgia Tech prohibits citizenship status, immigration status, and national origin discrimination in hiring, firing, and recruitment, except where such restrictions are required in order to comply with law, regulation, executive order, or Attorney General directive, or where they are required by Federal, State, or local government contract.

Other Information

This is not a supervisory position.

This position does not have any financial responsibilities.

This position will not be required to drive.

This role is not considered a position of trust.

This position does not require a purchasing card (P-Card).

This position will not travel.

This position does not require security clearance.

This position is located in San Diego, CA

Salary Job Grade T07

Salary range is dependent on candidate's experiences and skills that ranges from $112,410.00 - $164,062.00

Due to our research contracts with the U.S. federal government, candidates for this position must be U.S. Citizens.

Other Information

Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the non-profit, applied research arm of Georgia Tech. This position is in the Research Security Department of GTRI.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

About the Role:

The Junior
Data Analyst
will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do

Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.

Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:

Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Are proficient in Excel.
Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.

What's In It For You

Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.
A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
A scaling company with great industry professionals.
Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.

This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Supply Chain Performance & Insights
jobs.description:
The Data Analyst plays a key role in enabling data-driven decision making across ResMed's Global Distribution, Logistics & Trade organization. This role supports stakeholders across ResMed's global supply chain network and partners with teams across multiple regions and geographies.

As a member of the Global Supply Chain Performance & Insights team, you will transform complex operational data into actionable insights that improve service, reduce costs, increase efficiency, and support operational excellence across ResMed's global supply chain network.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution, Logistics, Transportation, Trade, Planning, Customer Operations, Finance, and Technology teams to develop dashboards, reporting solutions, performance metrics, and analytical insights that help teams make better business decisions.

This role is ideal for a data professional who enjoys solving business problems, uncovering insights from data, automating manual processes, and working in a highly collaborative global environment.

This is a global role supporting stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones. Candidates must be comfortable collaborating across a globally distributed organization and demonstrate flexibility to participate in occasional early-morning or evening meetings when needed to support regional stakeholders and global business priorities.

What You'll Do

Business Partnership & Insight Generation

Partner with global supply chain stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Work closely with regional stakeholders to understand operational challenges, business questions and reporting needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Develop a strong understanding of regional supply chain processes, operating models and business priorities.
Provide data-driven insights and recommendations that help stakeholders make informed operational decisions.
Participate in regional performance reviews and business discussions, providing analytical support and identifying trends, risks and opportunities.
Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different cultures, geographies and time zones.

Supply Chain Performance & Analytics

Analyze supply chain performance across areas including distribution, transportation, logistics, inventory and order fulfillment.
Monitor and analyze operational KPIs such as OTIF, service levels, transportation cost, warehouse productivity, inventory flow, freight utilization, carrier performance, logistics cost and customer experience metrics.
Identify performance trends, exceptions and emerging operational issues through recurring and ad hoc analysis.
Conduct structured root-cause analysis to understand operational performance gaps and identify potential improvement opportunities.
Support regional teams in evaluating operational trade-offs involving cost, service, inventory and capacity.
Measure the impact of operational improvements and initiatives through KPI tracking and post-implementation analysis.

Data Analysis & Reporting Solutions

Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting using Tableau and/or Power BI.
Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from enterprise systems.
Build scalable reporting datasets and analytical solutions that support business decision making.
Automate recurring reports and analytical workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to ensure data quality, consistency, and governance.
Maintain trusted KPI definitions, reporting standards, and business documentation.
Support self-service analytics capabilities that enable business users to access timely and reliable information.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analytical and reporting processes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by providing analysis that identifies process inefficiencies and quantifies improvement opportunities.
Participate in analytics and digital transformation initiatives across the global supply chain organization.
Explore new analytical capabilities, tools and technologies that can improve the way supply chain teams’ access and use information.
Contribute to the team's continued development of self-service, predictive and AI-enabled analytics capabilities.

Required Qualifications

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, operations analytics, supply chain analytics, or a related field.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing large datasets.
Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau and/or Power BI.
Demonstrated AI literacy, including the ability to effectively use AI-powered tools to enhance data analysis, reporting, problem solving, productivity, and decision making.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Strong organizational and prioritization abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities.
Ability to work independently and effectively within a global, cross-functional environment.
Willingness and flexibility to support stakeholders across global time zones, including occasional participation in meetings outside traditional local business hours when required.

What Sets You Apart

Experience within supply chain, logistics, transportation, distribution, manufacturing, healthcare, or medical device environments.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or similar technologies.
Experience using Python or other analytics programming languages.
Familiarity with data modeling, ETL processes, and data governance principles.
Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle.
Exposure to forecasting, statistical analysis, optimization, or AI-enabled analytics solutions.
Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple countries, regions, and time zones.

Core Competencies

Business Partnership

Builds strong relationships with stakeholders and understands how analytics can support operational objectives.

Analytical Excellence

Uses structured problem solving, critical thinking, and quantitative analysis to solve business challenges.

Data Storytelling

Communicates analytical findings clearly and effectively to drive understanding and action.

Technical Proficiency

Leverages data, reporting tools, and automation capabilities to create scalable analytical solutions.

Collaboration

Works effectively across functions, regions, and cultures to achieve shared business outcomes.

Continuous Improvement

Actively identifies opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and decision making.

Adaptability

Thrives in a dynamic global environment and effectively supports teams across multiple time zones.

jobs.title: Science Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Lasso Informatics

Research data is wild. It pours in from brain scans, genome sequencing, EEG and eye-tracking, biospecimens and wearables that track sleep and movement, across dozens of sites and years of study. Lasso Informatics ropes it in: our platform pulls it all into one place so researchers around the world can stop fighting with their data and get to discoveries faster. That is where our name comes from. A lasso brings something wild under control, and that is the job. The people who do it are Wranglers, and we are quite choosy about who earns the title. Wranglers expect a lot of themselves, make everyone around them better, and never stop learning. We move fast, we have fun, and we keep the bar high. 

What We Offer

A flexible, hybrid or remote position.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Work that matters, with scientific and clinical impact you can point to.
Variety that keeps it interesting: you work the whole analytics stack, from study design to insight, so no two projects feel the same.
Room to grow with a mission-driven company at the front of research data management.
A sharp, multidisciplinary team that is good at what it does and good to work with.

Full-Time |
US, Remote or Hybrid (Minneapolis)

US-based: $64,000 - $78,000 USD

Learn more and apply: https://careers.lassoinformatics.info/jobs/science-data-analyst

Want to Be a Wrangler? Here's What We Look For

You hold yourself to a high standard and bring real analytical rigor.
You make the people around you better.
You stay curious and keep learning.
You see a problem and start solving it, without waiting to be asked.
You keep the whole picture in view and notice how a change in one place ripples through the data, the study and the results.
You write clearly, document your methods with precision and explain complex statistical findings to non-technical audiences.
You juggle several priorities at once and work well on a distributed team.
You take data privacy, responsible stewardship and reproducibility seriously.

About the Role 

Read this part first, it saves us both time:
This is a health research role, not business intelligence, financial analytics or management consulting. We are looking for someone who comes from life sciences research and is at home in study design, biostatistics and the messy reality of participant data.

As a Science Data Analyst at Lasso, you sit inside a multidisciplinary research team and help answer real scientific questions. You shape analytical approaches, test them against study design, and turn tangled multi-modal data into findings that hold up. You are comfortable working alongside and communicating with people from every corner of the company, from researchers and software engineers to project managers. 

What You'll Do

 Work directly with researchers to define data requirements, resolve quality issues and support reproducible research workflows.
Conduct statistical analyses in R, Python and other tools, applying biostatistical methods suited to the study design, including mixed-effects models and longitudinal techniques.
Evaluate and contribute to experimental and study design decisions, making sure analyses are valid and that confounds, covariates and sampling are handled properly.
Apply statistical and computational methods for pattern detection, predictive modeling and data quality assessment across multi-modal datasets.
Organize and manage datasets and data dictionaries, run QC checks and conduct preliminary analyses that keep data integrity high.
Design, configure and maintain dashboards for domain-specific workgroups.
Produce clear documentation of your methods, pipelines and findings for scientific and internal audiences.
Maintain project tracking and help build a culture of rigorous, reproducible science.

Qualifications 

Required

A PhD in health or life sciences (for example epidemiology, public health, neuroscience, genetics, genomics, behavioral science or clinical and biomedical sciences). This one is firm: we want a researcher who analyzes data, not a data professional new to health research.
5+ years of full-time experience in data analysis and data science fundamentals (algorithms, data structures, data visualization), preferably in a clinical or research setting.
5+ years of full-time experience in a scientific programming language such as Python, R or Matlab, with hands-on familiarity with related frameworks and libraries (Tidyverse, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Polars).
Advanced proficiency in biostatistics, including methods suited to observational (cross-sectional and longitudinal) and experimental research designs.
Demonstrated experience applying experimental design principles: power analysis, randomization, control conditions and bias mitigation.
1+ year working in a Linux environment, using version control (e.g., GitHub) and software virtualization platforms (e.g., Docker).
Proficiency creating visualizations of complex longitudinal datasets.
3+ years working with data privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR) and research ethics standards.

Preferred

Background in neuroscience, genomics, clinical research or a related life sciences discipline.
Experience with large-scale, multi-modal research datasets spanning imaging, EEG, eye-tracking, wearables, behavioral, genetic or biosample data.
Familiarity with reproducible research practices including R Markdown, Quarto or equivalent notebook-based workflows.

Learn more and apply: https://careers.lassoinformatics.info/jobs/science-data-analyst

jobs.description:
Job Description

This position is based in Stamford, CT, and will support global Investment Technology initiatives. The candidate will primarily support the Alternative business and work closely with investment, operations, product, data, and technology teams. The role is office-based and requires regular in-person collaboration with business and technology partners.

Who We Are Looking For

State Street Investment Management is seeking a motivated, AI-forward Technical Business Analyst to join our Alternative Investment Technology team. This is a junior role with meaningful scope to grow, designed for someone who combines a solid technical foundation with strong communication skills and genuine curiosity about how technology and AI can improve the way we work.

The candidate will help gather requirements, analyze data and business processes, support system enhancements and reporting, and engage with stakeholders across the business. They should be comfortable working with data, learning new platforms quickly, and actively using AI tools and agent-based workflows to increase productivity, quality, and speed of delivery.

Working knowledge of SQL and at least one programming language is expected, with Python strongly preferred. A technical educational background is preferred.

Why This Role Is Important to Us

Our Alternative business depends on accurate data, reliable platforms, effective controls, and timely reporting. As we modernize our platforms and adopt AI-enabled ways of working, this role helps translate business needs into practical technology solutions, improves data quality and operational efficiency, and brings fresh, AI-first thinking to how the team delivers.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from investment, operations, product, and technology stakeholders.
Translate requirements into user stories, process flows, data mappings, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
Perform data analysis, validations, reconciliations, and root-cause analysis to support business initiatives and issue resolution.
Support data-quality activities, including exception management, remediation, and control checks.
Assist with the design and delivery of reports, dashboards, and analytics using SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
Identify opportunities to apply AI tools and AI agents to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve documentation and reporting.
Help design, test, and document AI-assisted and agent-based workflows, ensuring outputs are validated, controlled, and aligned with firm AI governance.
Participate in testing, release validation, user acceptance support, and post-production support activities.
Build relationships with business users, technology teams, and vendors; provide clear status updates and follow through on commitments.
Support platform enhancements, upgrades, issue resolution, onboarding, and user adoption.

Required Skills And Experience

AI Mindset and Utilization

AI-forward mindset with a genuine interest in how generative AI and agentic AI can transform business and technology processes.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar) for analysis, documentation, coding, and productivity.
Understanding of AI agents and agentic workflows, including how agents use tools, data, prompts, and orchestration to complete multi-step tasks.
Ability to write effective prompts, critically evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, and apply human review before use.
Awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, security, and model risk considerations in a regulated financial services environment.
Curiosity and learning agility to keep pace with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and apply them to real business problems.

Business Analysis and Stakeholder Management

Foundational experience or strong aptitude in requirements gathering, process analysis, and documentation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to business users.
Ability to build working relationships with stakeholders across investment, operations, technology, and vendor teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership, and ask the right questions.

Data Analysis Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and data-quality issues.
Exposure to data validation, reconciliations, and root-cause analysis.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge of SQL, including queries, joins, and basic data manipulation.
Programming knowledge in at least one language is required. Python is strongly preferred for data analysis, automation, and reporting.
Understanding of relational databases, data models, and data warehouse concepts.
Familiarity with ETL concepts, APIs, and file-based integrations is a plus.
Exposure to reporting and dashboard tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.

Domain and Platform Knowledge

The primary domain focus is Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Real Assets, Hedge Funds, and Fund-of-Funds. Interest in or basic knowledge of investment operations, portfolio accounting, performance measurement, and investment reporting is preferred.

Exposure to eFront products such as FrontInvest and Insight, or platforms like Burgiss, Argus, Dynamo, PFaroe, Preqin, or Aladdin, is an advantage but not required. Training will be provided.

Education And Preferred Qualifications

A bachelor's degree is required. A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or Economics is preferred.
0–3 years of relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, technology, or financial services; internships and project experience will be considered.
Coursework, certifications, or personal projects in AI, machine learning, data analytics, or automation are a strong plus.
Interest in financial services and alternative investments.

Work Environment

This role is based in our Stamford, CT office and requires regular in-office presence in line with firm workplace policy.
Collaboration with global teams across multiple time zones.
Structured mentoring and exposure to senior stakeholders, with a clear path for growth in scope and responsibility.

Success in This Role

The successful candidate will be a technically grounded, AI-forward analyst who communicates clearly and learns quickly. They will partner effectively with business and technology teams, use data and AI to solve problems, and help bring modern, agent-enabled ways of working into Alternative Investment Technology. Over time, they will grow into greater ownership of workstreams, stakeholder relationships, and delivery.

Salary Range

$65,000 - $113,750 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.
